stem: How is a source by two authors cited in brackets in APA style?
explanation: In running text, 'and' is used: Akinola and Usman (2017).
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: How are several sources supporting one point cited together in APA?

options.text: In one bracket, alphabetical, separated by semicolons
Only the most recent is cited

explanation: The order follows the first authors' surnames.
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: Which statements about the APA reference list are true?

options.text: It is in alphabetical order by first author
Works with no author are ordered by title
It is ordered by page number

explanation: Same-author, same-year works get letters a, b, c.
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: IEEE style uses numbered citations in square brackets and a numerically ordered reference list.
explanation: The author's name and date are not needed in the text.
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: Under the course book's APA rules, how is a source with three to five authors cited after the first time?

options.text: First author followed by et al.

explanation: Six or more authors use et al. from the first citation.
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: Which one is not a citation style named in the course?
explanation: Chicago/Turabian is the other style named.
source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: A source with no author is cited in the text by

options.text: A short title in quotation marks with the year

source: CSC 476 Research Methods in Computer Science.pdf, Unit 11

stem: In an APA journal article reference, the publisher and location are replaced by the journal title, volume, issue and pages.
